description: Write to an elected representative in a way that actually gets action — a specific ask, your local stake, why it's in their interest to respond, and the follow-up — instead of an angry email that gets auto-filed. Use when someone says 'write to my MP/congressperson/councillor', 'contact my representative about X', 'how do I get my rep to act', or 'my letter to the council got ignored'.
